description: Return a Kickstarter project's full detail (funding stats, story, risks, rewards, tags, creator, location, category, counts) from a project URL or creator/slug. Optional --include_comments / --include_updates load the comments/updates tabs via GraphQL. Runs in browser because node/curl are blocked by Cloudflare.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Project URL (https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/{creator}/{slug}) or creator/slug short form

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Load the comments tab via GraphQL CommentsQuery

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Number of top-level comments to load (1-100)

parameters.name: include_updates
parameters.description: Load the updates tab via GraphQL PostsFeed timeline

parameters.name: update_limit
parameters.description: Number of timeline items (updates) to load (1-100)
